zh.title: Schiebel展示無人直升機空中釋放小型無人機
zh.summary: Schiebel在奧地利以Camcopter S-100展示空中釋放小型無人機
body: Schiebel與合作夥伴Osiris Poland在奧地利進行概念驗證展示，從Camcopter S-100無人航空系統釋放小型無人機。釋放的機型是Osiris HSCD-1高速攝影無人機。
試驗影片顯示，一架HSCD-1從無人直升機側面的掛架脫離，當時直升機正向前飛行。Schiebel表示，釋放後的小型無人機透過S-100中繼的通訊鏈路進行操作；兩家公司認為，這項展示顯示S-100作為空中母機可能用於反無人機任務。

en.title: Schiebel demonstrates drone launch from airborne uncrewed helicopter
en.summary: Schiebel demonstrated a drone launch from the airborne Camcopter S-100 in Austria.
body: Schiebel and its partner Osiris Poland deployed a small uncrewed aircraft from the Camcopter S-100 in a proof-of-concept demonstration in Austria. The aircraft released was an Osiris HSCD-1, a high-speed camera drone.

Footage from the trial shows a single HSCD-1 dropping from a side-mounted fixture on the uncrewed helicopter while it flies forward. Schiebel says the smaller drone was operated after release through a communications link relayed via the S-100. Schiebel and Osiris Poland say the demonstration points to a possible counter-drone role for the S-100 as an airborne mothership.

zh.title: 廈門航空簽約採購50架波音737 MAX 8，2031年起分批交付
zh.summary: 中國南方航空11月24日公告，持股55%的廈門航空已與波音簽約購買50架737 MAX 8，目錄價合計約74億美元，預計2031至2034年分批交付，仍待中國主管機關與股東核准。
body: 中國南方航空11月24日在香港交易所公告，旗下持股55%的廈門航空已於當天收盤後與波音簽署購機協議，採購50架737 MAX 8（公告稱B737-8）。這筆交易須經中國相關政府部門核准後才生效，另須提交南方航空股東會審議。
公告指出，依波音提供的資料，50架飛機含機身與發動機的目錄價合計約74億美元；波音給予價格優惠，實際成交價低於目錄價，但受保密條款限制未予公布。飛機預計2031至2034年分批交付，價款以現金按各架交付進度分期支付，資金來自集團自有資金與銀行等機構的貸款或其他融資安排。
南方航空董事會說明，廈門航空將把握營運遷往廈門翔安國際機場的時機，發展福建樞紐網絡、改善航線布局並調整機隊結構；這次採購與集團先前訂購的137架空中巴士A320neo系列互補，向不同製造商購機有助分散機隊組合。由於與今年6月26日公告的5架777-8F及2架777F貨機採購合併計算後達到上市規則門檻，本案屬重大交易。
AeroTime報導，公告未說明這50架飛機是否計入中國今年5月承諾採購的200架波音飛機。

en.title: Xiamen Airlines signs for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets, with deliveries from 2031
en.summary: China Southern Airlines said on November 24 that its 55%-owned subsidiary Xiamen Airlines has agreed to buy 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft with a combined list price of about $7.4 billion. Deliveries are planned for 2031 to 2034, and the deal still needs Chinese government and shareholder approval.
body: China Southern Airlines said in a Hong Kong stock exchange filing on November 24 that Xiamen Airlines, in which it holds 55%, signed an agreement with Boeing after trading hours that day to buy 50 737 MAX 8 aircraft, which the filing refers to as the B737-8. The purchase takes effect only after approval by the relevant Chinese authorities and must also be put to China Southern’s shareholders at a general meeting.

According to the filing, Boeing’s catalogue price for the 50 aircraft, including airframes and engines, is about $7.4 billion. Boeing granted price concessions, so the actual consideration is lower, but it is not disclosed because of confidentiality provisions. The aircraft are to be delivered in stages from 2031 to 2034, with cash payments made in installments in line with each delivery. Funding will come from the group’s internal resources and from loans or other financing arranged with banks and other institutions.

China Southern’s board said Xiamen Airlines would use its relocation to Xiamen Xiang’an International Airport to develop its Fujian hub network, improve its route network and optimize its fleet. It said the purchase complements the group’s earlier order for 137 Airbus A320neo-family aircraft and that buying from different manufacturers diversifies the fleet. The deal counts as a major transaction under the listing rules, including when aggregated with the purchase of five 777-8F and two 777F freighters announced on June 26.
AeroTime reported that the filing does not say whether the 50 aircraft form part of the 200 Boeing jets China committed to buy in May.

facts.claim: 廈門航空（南方航空持股55%）11月24日收盤後與波音簽約採購50架B737-8，須經中國相關政府部門與股東核准。
50架飛機含機身與發動機的目錄價合計約74億美元，實際成交價較低且未公布。
飛機預計2031至2034年分批交付，價款以現金分期支付，資金來自集團自有資金與銀行等機構的貸款或其他融資安排。
董事會以遷往廈門翔安國際機場、發展福建樞紐網絡與調整機隊結構說明採購理由，並稱與先前訂購的137架A320neo系列互補；與6月26日公告的5架777-8F及2架777F採購合併計算後屬重大交易。
公告未說明這50架飛機是否計入中國今年5月承諾採購的200架波音飛機。
南方航空於11月24日以交易所公告揭露廈門航空與波音的50架737-8購機協議。

zh.title: 俄軍機接近南韓鬱陵島，當局短暫發布避難警報
zh.summary: 南韓軍方通報，11 月 24 日多架俄羅斯軍機進入南韓防空識別區並接近鬱陵島。當局一度要求島上居民就地避難，約三分鐘後解除。
body: 南韓聯合參謀本部表示，多架俄羅斯軍機 11 月 24 日清晨進入南韓防空識別區並接近鬱陵島。當地居民於上午 7 時 52 分收到避難通知，當局在三分鐘後解除警報。
南韓軍方後續說明，已確認俄軍機進入防空識別區並接近領空。防空識別區是用來辨識接近航空器的區域，與主權領空範圍有別。南韓外交部也表示，已就此事向俄羅斯表達關切。

en.title: South Korea briefly issues shelter alert on Ulleung Island as Russian aircraft approach
en.summary: South Korea’s military said several Russian aircraft entered its air defence identification zone and approached Ulleung Island on Nov. 24. Authorities lifted a brief shelter alert for the island about three minutes after issuing it.
body: South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff said several Russian military aircraft entered the country’s air defence identification zone early on Nov. 24 and approached Ulleung Island. Residents received a shelter alert at 7:52 a.m. local time, and officials lifted it three minutes later.

The military later clarified that the aircraft had been detected in the identification zone near the edge of South Korean airspace. An air defence identification zone extends beyond sovereign airspace. South Korea’s foreign ministry said it raised the incident with Russia.

facts.claim: The JCS reported entry into the air defence identification zone near Ulleung Island and South Korea raised it with Russia.
The shelter alert began at about 7:52 a.m. and was lifted three minutes later.

zh.title: 新加坡航空開航西雪梨國際機場，首班由總理黃循財搭乘
zh.summary: 新加坡航空 11 月 23 日開航樟宜機場至西雪梨國際機場，以空中巴士 A350-900 每天直飛。新加坡總理黃循財搭乘首班航班。
body: 新加坡航空首班 SQ261 於 11 月 23 日晚間抵達西雪梨國際機場（WSI）。機場表示，新加坡總理黃循財隨同國會代表團搭乘首班航班。
這條每日直飛航線使用空中巴士 A350-900。西雪梨機場全天營運，從當地出發的航班安排接近午夜起飛，隔天清晨抵達新加坡樟宜機場。

en.title: Singapore Airlines begins daily Western Sydney flights with PM Lawrence Wong on the first service
en.summary: Singapore Airlines began daily nonstop service between Changi and Western Sydney International Airport on Nov. 23. Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong travelled on the inaugural Airbus A350-900 flight.
body: Singapore Airlines flight SQ261 arrived at Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) on the evening of Nov. 23. The airport said Prime Minister Lawrence Wong travelled with a parliamentary delegation on the first flight.

The daily nonstop service uses an Airbus A350-900. Western Sydney Airport operates around the clock, allowing the Singapore-bound service to depart near midnight and reach Changi the following morning.

facts.claim: The airport announced daily nonstop Changi service from Nov. 23 and identified Lawrence Wong as a passenger on the first flight.
SQ261 arrived on Nov. 23 and the route uses the Airbus A350-900.
Australian Aviation identified the aircraft operating SQ261 as 9V-SHR.

zh.title: 波蘭通報俄羅斯無人機短暫進入領空，北約準備增派預警機
zh.summary: 波蘭軍方表示，11 月 23 日晚間一架俄羅斯無人機短暫進入波蘭領空。波蘭副國防部長認為這是蓄意行為，北約則準備加強支援。
body: 波蘭武裝部隊作戰司令部通報，11 月 23 日晚間一架俄羅斯無人機短暫進入波蘭領空。當時俄羅斯正對鄰近的烏克蘭西部發動攻擊。
波蘭副國防部長帕韋烏・扎萊夫斯基（Paweł Zalewski）隔天表示，他認為這次進入領空是蓄意行為。波蘭公共廣播電台報導，在近期一連串領空事件後，北約正準備增派空中預警機支援波蘭。

en.title: Poland reports brief Russian drone incursion as NATO prepares early warning support
en.summary: Poland’s military said a Russian drone briefly entered Polish airspace late on Nov. 23. A deputy defence minister said he believed the incursion was deliberate. NATO is preparing additional support.
body: Poland’s Armed Forces Operational Command reported that a Russian drone briefly entered Polish airspace late on Nov. 23. Russia was attacking neighbouring western Ukraine at the time.

Polish Deputy Defence Minister Paweł Zalewski said the next day that he believed the incursion was deliberate. Polish Radio reported that NATO was preparing additional airborne early warning support after a series of airspace incidents.

facts.claim: Poland’s Operational Command reported a brief Russian drone incursion late on Nov. 23.
The deputy defence minister said he believed the incursion was deliberate and NATO was preparing reinforcement.
Reuters independently reported the Polish military account.

zh.title: 燃油成本升高，航空公司評估飛機預付款融資與售後回租
zh.summary: 路透社報導，部分航空公司正評估用融資支付新機預付款，或把現有飛機出售後租回，以保留現金。不同機構統計對售後回租是否普遍增加仍有分歧。
body: 路透社依申報資料分析，七家美國上市航空公司今年前九個月的營收合計比去年同期增加近 280 億美元，燃油支出增加近 170 億美元，合計營業利益下降 12%。在現金流受壓的情況下，有業者向出租商尋求新機預付款融資，也有業者考慮售後回租。
路透社引述阿拉斯加航空財務長表示，借款和售後回租是 2027 年的選項。Cirium Ascend 統計今年前十個月有 73 架飛機採售後回租，高於去年同期 46 架。航空顧問公司 IBA 則未觀察到明顯增加。

en.title: Airlines weigh aircraft financing and leasebacks as fuel costs rise
en.summary: Some airlines are looking at financing aircraft delivery deposits or selling and leasing back aircraft to preserve cash, Reuters reported. Industry data providers differ on whether sale-leasebacks have increased more broadly.
body: Reuters analysed filings from seven publicly traded U.S. airlines and found that combined revenue rose nearly $28 billion year on year in the first nine months of 2026. Fuel expenses rose almost $17 billion and combined operating profit fell 12%. Some carriers have sought financing for aircraft pre-delivery payments or considered sale-leasebacks.

Reuters cited Alaska Air’s finance chief as saying borrowing and sale-leasebacks were among its options for 2027. Cirium Ascend counted 73 aircraft sold and leased back in the first ten months of the year, up from 46 a year earlier, while aviation consultancy IBA found no notable rise.

facts.claim: Reuters analysed seven publicly traded U.S. airlines, finding higher revenue and fuel expenses but a 12% fall in combined operating profit.
Reuters reported that Alaska Air was weighing options and Cirium Ascend and IBA differed on whether sale-leasebacks were increasing.

zh.title: 墨西哥航空將改裝波音 787，787-9 首設獨立豪華經濟艙
zh.summary: 墨西哥航空計畫在 2029 至 2031 年改裝波音 787 機隊。787-9 將增設獨立的豪華經濟艙及兩種商務艙套房。
body: 墨西哥航空公布波音 787 長程客艙改裝計畫，預計於 2029 至 2031 年間實施。787-9 將首次提供獨立的豪華經濟艙，商務艙提供兩種套房。
據 Aerospace Global News 報導，787-9 改裝後預計有 61 個高階艙等座位，合計商務艙與豪華經濟艙。較小的 787-8 將使用目前 787-9 的商務艙座椅。航空公司尚未公布豪華經濟艙的最終座位數或座椅尺寸。

en.title: Aeroméxico plans 787 cabin overhaul with its first dedicated premium economy on the 787-9
en.summary: Aeroméxico plans to overhaul its Boeing 787 cabins between 2029 and 2031. The 787-9 will gain a separate premium economy cabin and two types of business-class suite.
body: Aeroméxico announced a long-haul cabin overhaul for its Boeing 787 fleet, with installation planned between 2029 and 2031. The 787-9 will get the airline’s first dedicated premium economy cabin as well as two types of business-class suite.

Aerospace Global News reported that the refurbished 787-9 is expected to have 61 seats across business class and premium economy. The smaller 787-8 will receive the business-class seats currently used on the 787-9. Aeroméxico has yet to publish final seat counts or dimensions for the premium economy cabin.

facts.claim: Aeroméxico announced a 787 cabin overhaul for 2029 to 2031.
The 787-9 will have two business-class suite types and dedicated premium economy, with 61 premium seats in total.
The 787-8 will receive the 787-9’s current business seats.
